title.rendered: Winter Break – No School for Students, 12/23 – 1/6

content.rendered: There will be no school for students the weeks of 12/23 – 1/3 due to Winter Break. Monday, 1/6, will be a Professional Day for Teachers with no school for students. School will resume on Tuesday, 1/7.
